cluster.headline: כ-40% מהערבים הצביעו בעבר למפלגות ציוניות?
cluster.body_note: Server-rendered, read via fetch (summarized, not verbatim). Globes 'HaMashrokit' fact-check column by Uri Rosen, 24.11.2026, checking MK Avigdor Liberman's 20.11.26 interview claim (~41% of Arab voters chose Zionist parties in 1992; <14% in latest elections). Sub-headline: Liberman said over 40% in 1992 - in fact over 50%. Cites Abraham Initiatives compendium ch. 8 (1988: 41.6%; 1992: 52.3% record) and Moshe Dayan Center / Dr. Arik Rudnitzky (latest elections ~11%, mostly Druze; 93% of Druze voted Jewish parties; Muslim/Christian/Druze localities, excl. mixed cities).
